intro: Track Houston is a nonprofit founded in 1989. All donations are tax-deductible, and sponsorship puts your brand in front of one of the largest youth track audiences in the country — the annual Track Houston Championships draws over 6,500 athletes and spectators.

vendors.title: Vendor Village — Track Houston Championships
vendors.body: The Track Houston Championships is a two-day USATF-sanctioned meet each May with a dedicated Vendor Village. Apparel, jewelry, track & field memorabilia and other approved vendors can rent space for one or both days.

partners.name: VS Athletics
partners.blurb: Track Houston's preferred vendor for spikes, shoes and equipment. Use code TOR10 at checkout — a percentage of every sale comes back to the club.
